verdict.rationale: Vanta markets a built-in 'Vanta AI Agent' that drafts policies, completes questionnaires, reviews evidence, flags gaps, and a separate TPRM Agent that discovers vendors and monitors risk — all described as working inside the platform, which matches delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. However, the evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy with no product screenshots, hands-on walkthroughs, or independent confirmation of how a user actually invokes/delegates tasks to the assistant. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI Agent in actual use, UI/workflow detail on how a user delegates a task to it, and any limits/scope on what it can autonomously execute vs. suggest.
